Operating Instructions
for the
EX-5000 Industrial 3D Printer
The EX-5000 is designed for precise manufacturing.
Follow these steps for safe and efficient use:
1. Setup and Calibration: Place the printer on a stable, level surface
with at least 3 feet of clearance for ventilation. Connect to the
correct power source and turn it on. Use the touch screen to start
calibration, adjusting the print bed and extruder as directed.
2. Load Material: Open the rear filament compartment, insert the
spool, and feed it into the guide tube. Close the compartment
and select “Material Load” on the menu.
3. Print Job: Insert your design file via USB. Choose the file, confirm
settings (material, layer thickness, speed), and press “Start.”
Monitor progress on the display.
4. After Printing: Let the printer cool before removing the item.
Use the scraper tool carefully.
5. Safety: Avoid touching internal parts during operation and wear
safety goggles.
